fit_reason: Whole 2006 Sea Ray 260 Sundancer cruiser listed by a private owner in the boats by owner section.
findings: Gelcoat on the port and starboard topsides looks somewhat flat rather than deep gloss in the dock photos
Light dirt and scuffing on the swim platform and transom step area
Hoses and lines left coiled on the cockpit deck and transom, making the cockpit look cluttered
Some grime and staining around the transom and engine hatch edges
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Sea Ray 260 Sundancer. It looks well kept. A polish and wax would bring more shine to the hull sides, and a cleanup of the swim platform and cockpit would help the photos. We do pre-sale boat details and come to you. Would you like a quote?
